title: Context System API
description: Complete JavaScript reference for the runtime context object available inside the Code Panel. Access entities, physics, input, audio, camera, scenes, and variables.

blocks.content: The **Context System** (**context**) is the runtime API object passed into every node script in the [Custom Node & Code Panel](visual_scripting/custom_node_and_code). It provides safe, structured access to entities, physics, input, audio, camera, scenes, and variables during gameplay.

items.title: Domain Facades
items.desc: Control entities, colliders, audio channels, cameras, and scenes through dedicated namespaces.

items.title: Persistent State
items.desc: Store per-node timers, counters, and flags across frames in **context.state**.

items.title: Fail-Fast Assertions
items.desc: Validate entities, components, and numbers with **context.assert** before mutating state.

items.title: Contextual Logging
items.desc: Send tagged messages to the editor **Console** with **context.console**.

blocks.content: Every executing node receives root properties on **context** along with methods for reading and writing [Variables & Collections](visual_scripting/variables_and_collections).

blocks.message: Always validate required inputs and entities with **context.assert.exists()** or **context.assert.isNumber()** instead of silent fallback checks. If an assertion fails, the engine stops the node cleanly and logs the exact node location in the **Console** panel.

blocks.content: Inside the **Code Panel**, node scripts follow a consistent pattern to read inputs, call engine domain facades, and pass results downstream.

items: Read input ports from **inputs** and validate required values with **context.assert**.
Resolve the target [entity](components/entities_and_prefabs) using **context.entity.get(inputs.targetEntity)** (pass **'self'** to target **context.owner**).
Call the appropriate domain facade (such as **context.collider**, **context.input**, or **context.audio**) to query or update the game world.
Store any multi-frame timers or accumulators on **context.state**.
Assign output ports on **outputs**, set **outputs.execOut = true;** (for **Action** and **Event** nodes), and end with **return;**.

blocks.content: Use these spatial, hierarchy, physics, and input facades to interact with entities in the active scene.

rows: get(targetId), destroy(entity), destroyByTag(tag), clone(entity), getParent(entity), getChildren(entity), getRoot(entity), findClosestByTag(tag, origin, y?), getAllByTag(tag), findByName(name), findByScriptId(scriptId)
Resolves entities by **'self'**, UUID, or **scriptId**, traverses parent-child hierarchies, queries tags, and clones or destroys entities.
Spawns a new prefab instance into the scene at coordinates **(x, y)**.
get(layerId), destroy(layerId, destroyEntities?), freezeInput(layerId, active?, type?), isInputFrozen(layerId, type?)
Resolves display layers, removes layers, or freezes pointer and keyboard input on a specific layer.
moveAndSlide(entity, moveX, moveY), checkSolid(entity), checkOverlap(entity, filterTag?)
Moves kinematic bodies with wall sliding and checks solid collisions or trigger overlaps on [Multi-Collider](components/multi_collider) shapes.
getPointer(), mouse, keyboard.isDown(key), keyboard.isPressed(key), keyboard.isReleased(key), raycast.getTopEntity(), isPointerOver(entity, useRaycast?)
Reads pointer coordinates, mouse buttons, keyboard state, and top Z-indexed entities under the cursor.

blocks.content: Use these presentation, audio, scene, and gameplay toolkit facades to control cameras, sound channels, scene transitions, and high-level mechanics.

rows: follow(targetEntity, speed?, offset?), stopFollow(), snapTo(x, y), setTransform(x, y, scale?, speed?), getInfo(), x, y, scale, lerp
Follows a target entity smoothly, teleports the camera, or adjusts viewport zoom and position.
play(targetOrAssetId, options?), stop(targetOrId), stopAll(), setVolume(channel, volume), getVolume(channel), setMute(channel, isMute), isMuted(channel)
Plays or stops [Audio Source](components/audio_source) sounds and controls the **master**, **background**, **sfx**, and **voice** mixer channels (0 to 100).
Runs a full-screen fade transition (**'fade_in'**, **'fade_out'**, or **'fade'**).
load(sceneName), restart(), getCurrentName(), getCurrentId(), getCurrentData(), getAllScenes(), injectLayer(sceneName, layerName, inheritState?, targetLayer?)
Switches or reloads scenes and injects layers from another scene (such as a shared HUD overlay).
Resolves project asset metadata or converts an asset **scriptId** into its UUID.
High-level helpers used by [Helper & Tool](node_library/helper_tool) preset and template nodes.

blocks.message: Never access **context.game** inside node scripts. The **Code Panel** validator flags unrecognized root properties and enforces access through the documented **context** domain facades.
